scope.actuator: Long fractional UPRO for bullish or SPXU for bearish

frozen_signal.instrument_block_spread: median of at least twelve valid one-minute proportional spreads
frozen_signal.block_surcharge: SPXU median proportional spread divided by SH median proportional spread
frozen_signal.bullish: second-block surcharge strictly below first-block surcharge
frozen_signal.bearish: second-block surcharge strictly above first-block surcharge
frozen_signal.no_trade: exact tie, invalid quote, or any incomplete block

execution.baseline_cost: full observed bid-ask spread at entry and exit
execution.cost_stress: one additional cent per share adverse at entry and exit

mechanism_contrasts.sign_flipped: trade the opposite ETF on every actual signal date
mechanism_contrasts.raw_sh_spread_change: use contraction/expansion of SH proportional spread alone with the same sign map and clocks
mechanism_contrasts.raw_spxu_spread_change: use contraction/expansion of SPXU proportional spread alone with the same sign map and clocks

prohibited_after_results: add an absolute spread, ratio, or change threshold
use displayed size, price direction, volume, weekday, month, year, or volatility filters
select SH or SPXU raw spread after comparing controls
combine v33 with v17 or v28 based on outcomes
open holdout after any development-gate failure
evidence_warning: A historical survivor would remain a forward-paper candidate requiring new data; it would not guarantee live profitability.
